# Agent Architecture

## Summary

How autonomous agents are composed: a model, a tool loop, memory, and guardrails.

## Details

The agent observes, decides, and acts, then observes the result. [[MCP Security]] is a
critical concern. See [[Tool Use Loop]] for the core cycle.
